34: #ifndef _PDF_INPUT_DEVICE_H_
35: #define _PDF_INPUT_DEVICE_H_
36: 
37: #include <istream>
38: #include <ios>
39: #include <cstdio>
40: 
41: #include "PdfDefines.h"
42: #include "PdfLocale.h"
43: 
44: namespace PoDoFo {
45: 
46: /** This class provides an Input device which operates 
47:  *  either on a file, a buffer in memory or any arbitrary std::istream
48:  *
49:  *  This class is suitable for inheritance to provide input 
50:  *  devices of your own for PoDoFo.
51:  *  Just overide the required virtual methods.
52:  */
53: class PODOFO_API PdfInputDevice {
54:  public:
55: 
56:     /** Construct a new PdfInputDevice that reads all data from a file.
57:      *
58:      *  \param pszFilename path to a file that will be opened and all data
59:      *                     is read from this file.
60:      */
61:     PdfInputDevice( const char* pszFilename );
62: 
63: #ifdef _WIN32
64:     /** Construct a new PdfInputDevice that reads all data from a file.
65:      *
66:      *  \param pszFilename path to a file that will be opened and all data
67:      *                     is read from this file.
68:      *
69:      *  This is an overloaded member function to allow working
70:      *  with unicode characters. On Unix systes you can also path
71:      *  UTF-8 to the const char* overload.
72:      */
73:     PdfInputDevice( const wchar_t* pszFilename );
74: #endif // _WIN32
75: 
76:     /** Construct a new PdfInputDevice that reads all data from a memory buffer.
77:      *  The buffer will not be owned by this object - it is COPIED.
78:      *
79:      *  \param pBuffer a buffer in memory
80:      *  \param lLen the length of the buffer in memory
81:      */
82:     PdfInputDevice( const char* pBuffer, size_t lLen );
83: 
84:     /** Construct a new PdfInputDevice that reads all data from a std::istream.
85:      *
86:      *  \param pInStream read from this std::istream
87:      */
88:     PdfInputDevice( const std::istream* pInStream );
89: 
90:     /** Destruct the PdfInputDevice object and close any open files.
91:      */
92:     virtual ~PdfInputDevice();
93: 
94:     /** Close the input device.
95:      *  No further operations may be performed on this device
96:      *  after calling this function.
97:      */
98:     virtual void Close();
99: 
100:     /** Get the current position in file.
101:      *  /returns the current position in the file
102:      */
103:     virtual std::streamoff Tell() const;
104: 
105:     /** Get next char from stream.
106:      *  \returns the next character from the stream
107:      */
108:     virtual int GetChar() const;
109: 
110:     /** Peek at next char in stream.
111:      *  /returns the next char in the stream
112:      */
113:     virtual int Look() const;
114: 
115:     /** Seek the device to the position offset from the begining
116:      *  \param off from the beginning of the file
117:      *  \param dir where to start (start, cur, end)
118:      *
119:      *  A non-seekable input device will throw an InvalidDeviceOperation.
120:      */
121:     virtual void Seek( std::streamoff off, std::ios_base::seekdir dir = std::ios_base::beg );
122: 
123:     /** Read a certain number of bytes from the input device.
124:      *  
125:      *  \param pBuffer store bytes in this buffer.
126:      *                 The buffer has to be large enough.
127:      *  \param lLen    number of bytes to read.
128:      *  \returns the number of bytes that have been read.
129:      *           If reading was successfull the number of read bytes
130:      *           is equal to lLen.
131:      */
132:     virtual std::streamoff Read( char* pBuffer, std::streamsize lLen );
133: 
134:     /**
135:      * \return True if the stream is at EOF
136:      */
137:     PODOFO_NOTHROW inline virtual bool Eof() const;
138: 
139:     /**
140:      * \return True if there was an error in an I/O operation
141:      */
142:     PODOFO_NOTHROW inline virtual bool Bad() const;
143: 
144:     /**
145:      * Set the stream error state. By default, clears badbit, eofbit
146:      * and failbit.
147:      */
148:     PODOFO_NOTHROW inline virtual void Clear( std::ios_base::iostate state = std::ios_base::goodbit) const;
149: 
150:     /**
151:      * \return True if the stream is seekable. Subclasses can control
152:      * this value with SetIsSeekable(bool) .
153:      */
154:     PODOFO_NOTHROW inline bool IsSeekable() const;
155:  protected:
156:     /**
157:      * Control whether or or not this stream is flagged
158:      * seekable.
159:      */
160:     PODOFO_NOTHROW inline void SetSeekable(bool bIsSeekable);
161: 
162:     /** CAN NOT Construct a new PdfInputDevice without an input source. 
163:      *  However subclasses may well need to do just that.
164:      */
165:     PdfInputDevice();
166: 
167:  private: 
168:     /** Initialize all private members
169:      */
170:     void Init();
171: 
172:  private:
173:     std::istream* m_pStream;
174: 	  FILE *				m_pFile;
175:     bool          m_StreamOwned;
176:     bool          m_bIsSeekable;
177: };
178: 
179: bool PdfInputDevice::IsSeekable() const
180: {
181:     return m_bIsSeekable;
182: }
183: 
184: void PdfInputDevice::SetSeekable(bool bIsSeekable)
185: {
186:     m_bIsSeekable = bIsSeekable;
187: }
188: 
189: bool PdfInputDevice::Bad() const
190: {
191:     if (m_pStream)
192:         return m_pStream->bad();
193:     return m_pFile != NULL;
194: }
195: 
196: bool PdfInputDevice::Eof() const
197: {
198:     if (m_pStream)
199:         return m_pStream->eof();
200:     if (m_pFile)
201:         return feof(m_pFile) != 0;
202:     return true;
203: }
204: 
205: void PdfInputDevice::Clear(std::ios_base::iostate state) const
206: {
207:     if (m_pStream)
208:         m_pStream->clear(state);
209: }
210: 
211: };
212: 
213: #endif // _PDF_INPUT_DEVICE_H_
